definitions.explanation: Describes being deeply absorbed in something beautiful or pleasant, in a dreamy state of admiration.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{歌声|うたごえ}→歌声：20116_utagoe⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧うっとり⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I'm enchanted by her singing voice.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夜景|やけい}→夜景：10434_yakei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧うっとり⟦{眺|なが}めた→眺める：02132_nagameru⟧。
examples.english: I gazed at the night view in a dreamy state.

examples.japanese: うっとり⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ような→よう：01114_you⟧⟦{香|かお}り→香り：00189_kaori⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧⟦ピアノ→ピアノ：01376_piano⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{音色|ねいろ}→音色：07422_neiro⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧うっとり⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{忘|わす}れた→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧。
examples.english: I was so captivated by the beautiful piano sound that I lost track of time.

notes:
An onomatopoeic (mimetic) word describing a dreamy, enchanted state of being absorbed in something beautiful or pleasant.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- うっとり⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to be entranced, to be captivated
- うっとり⟦{見|み}とれる→見とれる：15134_mitoreru⟧: to gaze in admiration
- うっとり⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ような→よう：01114_you⟧〜: enchanting, captivating (modifying a noun)
- うっとり⟦{眺|なが}める→眺める：02132_nagameru⟧: to gaze dreamily

COMMON TRIGGERS:
- ⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧⟦{景色|けしき}→景色：01395_keshiki⟧: beautiful scenery
- ⟦{音楽|おんがく}→音楽：00661_ongaku⟧/⟦{歌声|うたごえ}→歌声：20116_utagoe⟧: music / singing voice
- ⟦{香|かお}り→香り：00189_kaori⟧: fragrance
- ⟦{美|び}{人|じん}→美人：01600_bijin⟧: a beautiful person

USAGE:
うっとり implies a positive, pleasant absorption — losing oneself in beauty. It suggests a momentary loss of awareness of surroundings. Not used for negative fascination or obsession.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{見|み}とれる→見とれる：15134_mitoreru⟧: to be charmed by looking at something (specifically visual)
- ⟦ぼんやり→ぼんやり：03727_bonyari⟧: absent-minded, in a daze (neutral/negative — not necessarily pleasant)
- ⟦うっとうしい→うっとうしい：06169_uttoushii⟧: gloomy, depressing (different word despite similar sound)
